prohibited_claims: experimental fitting calibration or measured predictive accuracy
physical VTH SS mobility Ion Ioff DOS contact or temperature parameters
independent external validation because train and holdout originate from the same frozen teaching model
AIM-Spice or ngspice validation before M01 execution
equation identity between native AIM-Spice Level 15 and ngspice behavioral routes
circuit-ready active-load model quantitative circuit results layout PEX or HZO evidence
